item.stem:
The diagram shows the given data for $\triangle STU$: $ST = 9\,\mathrm{cm}$, $SU = 7\,\mathrm{cm}$, and included $\angle S = 45^{\circ}$. Pallavi must construct the triangle.

One or more options may be correct. Which two claims belong in a correct construction plan?

options.A: Name the finished triangle as the phrase base side, and stop.
options.B: Draw $ST = 9\,\mathrm{cm}$ as a base and make a $45^{\circ}$ angle at $S$.
options.C: Mark $SU = 7\,\mathrm{cm}$ along the new arm from $S$, then join $U$ to $T$.
options.D: Copy the printed $45$ alone and treat that numeral as the finished triangle.
